status: No migration screen opens an overlay today (every screen declares OVERLAY_MODE NONE: decisions are inline — choice bars, radio rows, expandable rows). These rules bind the first page that needs one.

SHEET.MOBILE: bottom sheet: full width, top radius 26u, drag handle, max-height 88dvh, content scrolls inside; sits above the dock (z 50) and leaves BOTTOM_SAFE_AREA
SHEET.TABLET: edge sheet: anchored to the bottom, width min(640px, 100% − 2×PAGE_GUTTER), centred, radius 22px; or a right edge sheet 420px for record inspection; the dock stays visible beneath the scrim
SHEET.DESKTOP: modal (centred, max 640px, for confirmations) or inspector (right panel 420px inside the workspace, for record detail beside the table); never covers the sidebar
SHEET.behaviour: focus moves into the overlay and is trapped; Escape and the scrim close it; focus returns to the trigger; body scroll locks; role=dialog with aria-modal and a labelled title
SHEET.actions: one gold primary at the bottom right (desktop) / full width (mobile, tablet); secondary actions are outline buttons

transformations.MOBILE→TABLET: bottom sheet → centred edge sheet with a max width (no full-bleed sheet on a wide screen)
transformations.TABLET→DESKTOP: edge sheet → modal (decision) or inspector panel (record detail)

actorRule: overlays inherit the actor shell; a client overlay never offers staff actions or links into /office
